# runzero_asset_ownership_types (Data Source)

Fetches a list of RunZero asset ownership types.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `asset_ownership_types` (Attributes List) List of asset ownership types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset_ownership_types))

<a id="nestedatt--asset_ownership_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asset_ownership_types`

Read-Only:

- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the asset ownership type is hidden.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the asset ownership type.
- `name` (String) The name of the asset ownership type.
- `order` (Number) The display order of the asset ownership type.
- `reference` (Number) The reference number of the asset ownership type.
